context: A police officer briefs on security
purpose: Teach: 配線/一周/進め方/納入/現職/心構え/立ち上がる/取り組ま

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の配線、防犯面でも、再点検をお願いします。
lines.en: We'd like you to have your wiring checked again from a security standpoint.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Slight pause after the opening phrase. Even tone, no pressure — this is procedure, not accusation. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察車両、敷地を一周する巡回、お願いしています。
lines.en: Of course. We've already arranged for police vehicles to patrol the perimeter.
lines.style: Respectful, eager to demonstrate competence. Slight forward lean in the voice. Quick, clean delivery on the concrete action. Not defensive — just showing readiness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 手続きの進め方、警察庁ガイドライン、共有します。
lines.en: I'll share the National Police Agency guidelines on how to structure the process.
lines.style: Clear, informative tone. Treats this as routine handoff. No condescension — speaking to someone who will follow through. Slightly official register but warm underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。協定書、警察に納入しました。
lines.en: Yes, we've already submitted the partnership agreement to the police.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Brief, factual. Slight note of quiet pride — demonstrating they're ahead of the curve. No embellishment, just competent reporting.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 現職員のうち、警察出身者、いますか。
lines.en: Do you have anyone on your current staff with a law enforcement background?
lines.style: Genuine question, not probing. Conversational but official. Opens the door for them to explain, interested in their answer. Warm but detached.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、心構え研修、警察と共催です。
lines.en: Yes. We're running a training program on mindset and procedure — it's co-hosted with the police.
lines.style: Confident, slightly proud. Delivery picks up pace slightly — this is something they've invested in. Shows initiative. Warm at the edges.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 共同プロジェクト、立ち上がるのは、来年です。
lines.en: The joint project will officially launch next year.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, forward-looking. Sets timeline with clarity. No rush in the voice, just factual roadmap. Slightly reassuring — they know the schedule.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。難案件にも取り組ませる方針です。
lines.en: Right. Our approach is to have the team take on challenging cases from the start.
lines.style: Steady, purposeful. Slight emphasis on 'challenging' — shows ambition but not recklessness. Measured pace, confident. Closing statement that signals readiness.
